question: Under what duration of practice is old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: The duration specified is one year.
The condition is that it has been practiced when or for that time.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The verse does not specify the exact practice being referred back to.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
